cohort_summary: Pick'em players (3 pros, 7 amateurs, 8 on phone) found real value in the 1+ Hit / 1+ HR boards sorted by Prob (1+ Hit maps to Hits 0.5 More) plus Upcoming/Lineup-confirmed filters and fast search. But the product does not speak pick'em: no posted line, every starter has the same fixed O 5.5 Ks / O 16.5 outs, only the over side, no breakeven (54.2%/57.7%) framing, key stats missing (HRR 1.5, fantasy score, rankable TB), starters not sortable, and no way to build or save a 2-6 pick entry. Pros can salvage the 'exp' means; amateurs mostly stall or abandon. 0 full successes, 8 partial, 2 failed.
